# T-6: Bind coordination recovery

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Unify managed-worktree coordination authority and make review recovery decisions depend on the current binding and canonical review-input digest.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Main-repository and managed-worktree invocations for one explicit target resolve the same binding and main-root dispatcher lock authority.
- A changed canonical review-input digest prevents reuse of an old exhausted provider blocker.
- Unchanged input can receive only one audited same-binding provider retry per fresh dispatcher invocation.

## Implementation Notes
Keep process-owned coordination in the canonical main repository and artifact mutation in the bound worktree. Represent recovery receipt identity with a class that validates runId, Issue/no-Issue, spec, step, tree, target-state digest, and dispatch invocation scope. Do not branch on provider name, Issue number, spec directory, or artifact filename.

## Test Strategy
Add unit convergence/receipt tests and a managed-worktree E2E covering both invocation roots and stale blocker invalidation.
